title: Implement V4 ArchUnitNET compiled-assembly adapter
goal: Enforce three compiled architecture claims from explicit hash-bound assemblies without building or executing the target repository.
acceptanceCriteria: ArchUnitNET and its runtime dependency closure are pinned and loaded without network access.
Only explicit assemblies beneath EvidenceRoot with matching hashes and identities are inspected.
Compiled dependency, implementation placement and assembly placement claims emit layered findings and non-zero coverage.
Missing dependencies, assemblies and zero-match evidence fail explicitly.
The adapter does not build or mutate TargetRoot and P0-P4C remain green.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged with no active workflow or remote change.
